title: Battambang vs Kampot: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Kampot for relaxation and nature; Battambang for authentic city culture and the bamboo train experience. Do both if you have 10+ days in Cambodia.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Battambang has richer Khmer food culture and the stunning colonial Psar Nath market. Kampot wins for the Kep crab + Kampot pepper experience.

categories.name: Cultural Attractions
categories.summary: Bamboo train, bat caves, Phare Circus, Angkorian temples — Battambang packs more into 2 days.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Both cities are ~$20–35/day budget. Battambang very slightly cheaper.

categories.name: Getting There
categories.summary: 3h from Phnom Penh vs 5–6h for Battambang.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Kampot has a real riverside bar scene; Battambang is quieter (though the Phare Circus compensates).

categories.name: Nature & Outdoors
categories.summary: Bokor National Park, river kayaking, and Kep give Kampot a clear nature edge.

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Battambang: bat caves + bamboo train. Kampot: Bokor Mountain + Kep crab. Both excellent.

categories.name: Authenticity
categories.summary: Fewer tourists, real Cambodian city life.

faq.question: Is Battambang or Kampot better for first-time Cambodia visitors?
faq.answer: Kampot edges ahead — easier to reach (3h from Phnom Penh) and naturally pairs with Kep crab.

faq.question: How do I get from Battambang to Kampot?
faq.answer: Route through Phnom Penh — no direct bus.
